name: Attention-velocity ignition — accel spike + momentum confirm (1h, fast)
rationale: MECHANISM: same attention-onset lead as the 4h variant but run at a FASTER 1h cadence to catch the ignition earlier, gated by a small positive short-horizon return so we only take accel spikes that price is already beginning to confirm (avoids buying an attention blip with no flow). social_volume_accel = ln(v_t/v_{t-1}); the counterparty is slow dashboard-driven retail that repositions a day late. The CHANGE (not level) is the signal. Entry LONG when accel clears a fitted spike floor AND a short ret_Nd is positive. Exit on accel decay or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER: this is the SAME onset thesis at higher frequency, so it must beat the 4h variant net of the ~more-frequent round-trip fees, not merely fire more; a 1h edge that dies once fees scale with turnover is not real. Shuffle the attention series — survival under shuffle = price autocorrelation, KILL. The momentum gate must not simply reduce this to a pure price-momentum spec: ablate accel out and the residual must collapse.
catalyst: attention acceleration confirmed by nascent positive short-horizon momentum
